name: openseo
description: Research keywords and competitors, audit sites, track rankings, and use connected Search Console data from your AI assistant.

interface.longDescription:
Get found on Google and recommended by AI.

With the OpenSEO plugin, ChatGPT can use SEO data and your saved project context to give advice tailored to your business.

Research keywords, analyze competitors and backlinks, and run technical site audits directly in ChatGPT.
defaultPrompt: Research keywords for my site and shortlist the best opportunities.
Audit my site and give me a one-page report with a single next action.
Track my rankings for these keywords and summarize what changed.
